blurb: Deerfield Golf Club features an 18-hole golf course designed by Edward Lawrence Packard with five sets of tees including family golf tees for different ages and abilities. Junior golfers under 12 must be accompanied by an adult and play from shorter tees. The club offers various leagues, permanent tee times, and seasonal passes with resident and non-resident rates.
extraNote: Tee times require credit card authorization to book online; payment at pro shop · Permanent tee time groups must purchase a Limited Seasonal Pass or 20-Round Weekend Pass · Cancel tee times by close of business two days prior to avoid no-show penalty · No-show penalty: $58 charge for resident limited pass holders, $68 for non-residents, or one round deducted for 20-round pass holders · Exceptions to no-show penalties include weather delays, frost, lightning, precipitation over 0.3 inches, temperature below 50°F, or emergencies
